results.content: YouGov polls about 1,500 members of its national opt-in panel weekly using online questionnaires. State-level approval rates are “estimated” based on demographic characteristics, voting behavior, the state’s voting history and other data. Nationally, YouGov’s tracker shows 34% approving of Trump’s job performance and 61% disapproving, for a net approval rating of -27.

results.content: The survey, released Aug. 11, found that 33% of Americans approve of Trump’s performance, down 3 percentage points from the previous week. This marks the lowest approval rating the president has seen in YouGov tracking since he returned to office in 2025.
results.title: Trump approval falls to new low as voters say U.S. is 'out of control"

results.content:
Methodology

Each week, YouGov invites around 1,500 members of its opt-in panel to complete an online questionnaire. The respondents are selected to be representative of American adult citizens and the data is weighted to represent the country according to gender, age, race, education and voting behaviour. To track the results of YouGov’s polling over time, The Economist aggregates survey data each week and fits a line of best fit.
